<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Big Sloth 59</title>
<style>
/* Big Sloth 59 by ozgeozkaraa01 — https://uiverse.io/ozgeozkaraa01/big-sloth-59 */
.input {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 14px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding-left: 10px;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  outline: none;
}

.input:focus {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #6941c6;
  -webkit-transition: 0.1s;
  transition: 0.5s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="text" name="text" class="input" placeholder="Type...">

</body>
</html>
